text:
Given: Initial height: 8 m, Rebound ratio: 3/4, The initial impact is the first ground contact, The total distance is measured through the fifth ground contact
Find: The total distance traveled by the ball through its fifth contact with the ground

1. Identify the given quantities and the stopping condition
   The ball is initially dropped from 8 m. Each rebound reaches three-fourths of the height from which the preceding descent began. We stop when the ball reaches the ground for the fifth time.

2. List the rebound heights
   h₁=8 (frac 34 )=6 m, h₂=8 (frac 34 )²=frac 92 m, h₃=8 (frac 34 )³=(27)/(8) m, h₄=8 (frac 34 )⁴=(81)/(32) m
   The first ground contact is followed by a rebound to height h_1. The fifth ground contact is reached after four rebound journeys, so the relevant rebound heights are h_1 through h_4.

3. Separate the initial drop from the rebound journeys
   D=8+2(h₁+h₂+h₃+h₄)
   The initial 8 m drop is traveled only once. Each rebound height is traveled twice: once upward and once downward before the next ground contact.

4. Recognize the geometric series
   h₁+h₂+h₃+h₄=6+frac 92+(27)/(8)+(81)/(32)
   The rebound heights form the finite geometric series with first term 6 m and common ratio 3/4.

5. Use the finite geometric-series formula
   h₁+h₂+h₃+h₄=6(1- (frac 34 )⁴)/(1-frac 34)
   For a finite geometric series, the sum of n terms is a(1-r^n)/(1-r). Here, a=6 m, r=3/4, and n=4.

6. Substitute the geometric-series sum into the total-distance formula
   D=8+2 [6(1- (frac 34 )⁴)/(1-frac 34) ]
   The initial 8 m drop is combined with twice the sum of the four rebound heights.

7. Evaluate and check the total distance
   D=8+2 (6+frac 92+(27)/(8)+(81)/(32) )=(653)/(16) m=40.8125 m=40(13)/(16) m
   Evaluating the four rebound heights and adding their upward and downward distances to the initial 8 m drop gives the total distance traveled before the fifth ground contact. The result is expressed as an exact fraction, a mixed number, and a decimal.

Answer: D=8+2 [6(1- (frac 34 )⁴)/(1-frac 34) ]=(653)/(16) m=40.8125 m=40(13)/(16) m
The ball first travels 8 m downward. Before its fifth ground contact, it then travels upward and downward through four rebound heights: 6 m, 9/2 m, 27/8 m, and 81/32 m. Therefore, the total distance is the initial drop plus twice the finite geometric sum of these rebound heights: 40.8125 m, or 40 13/16 m.

operations.title: The stopping condition
operations.narration: The ball is dropped from a height of 8 metres. We count distance until it reaches the ground for the fifth time.

operations.title: Four rebound heights
operations.caption: h_k=8\left(\frac34\right)^k
operations.narration: After the first contact, the ball rises to six metres. Each later rebound is three-fourths of the previous one, and only four rebound heights occur before the fifth contact.

operations.title: Count each journey
operations.caption: D=8+2(h_1+h_2+h_3+h_4)
operations.narration: The initial eight-metre drop happens only once. Each rebound height is traveled twice: once going up and once coming back down.

operations.title: The finite sum
operations.caption: h_1+h_2+h_3+h_4=6+\frac92+\frac{27}{8}+\frac{81}{32}
operations.narration: The rebound heights form a finite geometric series: six, then nine-halves, then twenty-seven-eighths, then eighty-one-thirty-seconds.

operations.title: Use the geometric formula
operations.caption: S_n=a\frac{1-r^n}{1-r}
operations.narration: For a finite geometric series, the sum is a times one minus r to the n, divided by one minus r. Here, a is six metres, r is three-fourths, and n is four.

operations.title: Substitute the sum
operations.caption: D=8+2\left[6\frac{1-\left(\frac34\right)^4}{1-\frac34}\right]
operations.narration: Substitute the geometric-series sum into the distance formula. The initial drop remains eight metres, and the rebound sum is still doubled.

operations.title: Evaluate the distance
operations.caption: D=\frac{653}{16}\text{ m}=40.8125\text{ m}
operations.narration: Adding the four rebound heights, counting each twice, and then adding the initial drop gives an exact total of six hundred fifty-three sixteenths metres, or 40.8125 metres.

operations.title: FINAL ANSWER
operations.caption: D=40.8125\text{ m}=40\frac{13}{16}\text{ m}
operations.narration: Therefore, before the ball reaches the ground for the fifth time, it travels 40.8125 metres in total, which is also 40 and 13 sixteenths metres.
